subject: Subprocessor change notice — consent path, DPA package and MSA coordination
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jillian Moore <jillian@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Subprocessor change notice — EdgeCloud + DPA materials attached

Hi Jillian,

Quick heads-up: we're onboarding EdgeCloud (edgecloud.io) as a subprocessor for logging/observability for a small subset of inference telemetry. Attached is the Q1 subprocessor list and the redline to the MSA/Order Form we propose for Acme.

What I need from your side:
- Confirmation of the procurement/PO path and who signs the order form (procurement@acme-corp.com is CC'd).
- Any DPA redline marks the legal team needs us to address prior to routing to DocuSign.
- Let me know if you need additional security evidence (SOC 2 report, scoping) — Vivek is on this thread and can provide details.

Attachments: subprocessor_list_Q1_2027.pdf

Proposed timeline: we can have a final Order Form + DPA package for signature by end of week if we get redlines back by Wed.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

--
Attachment: subprocessor_list_Q1_2027.pdf (list of subprocessors, roles, and data access scope)

From: Jillian Moore <jillian@acme-corp.com>

Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 9 Jan 2027 12:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subprocessor change notice — EdgeCloud + DPA materials attached

Camila — thanks for the update. A couple quick asks from Acme procurement/legal: 

- Please share a DPA redline summary (high level) that indicates any clauses that materially change data residency, rights to audit, or subprocessor flow-down obligations.
- Procurement needs an estimated lead time for PO/DocuSign execution (we typically require 3 business days for internal routing).
- Security will want SOC 2 Type II or a recent third-party assessment for EdgeCloud before we approve. If EdgeCloud cannot provide that, they will need to accept a narrower scoping of data and an audit right.

We'll target a decision by EOD Thu if we get the redline summary and evidence by Tue.

Best,
Jillian
Director, Platform Partnerships | Acme Corp

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Subprocessor change notice — Acme asks (DPA summary + evidence)

Team — forwarding Acme's reply. They want a DPA summary and SOC2 evidence for EdgeCloud.

Plan I propose:
1) Legal (Monica + Rishi) to pull the redline_MSA and produce a 1-page "DPA delta summary" that calls out: data residency, audit rights, subprocessor flow-down, and incident reporting SLA.
2) Security (Vivek) to confirm whether EdgeCloud's current controls are acceptable or whether we should propose scoping limitations.
3) I'll consolidate and send the package back to Acme with the order form link.

I've attached the redline of the MSA/Order Form from our side. Please mark the priority items in the doc and add one-paragraph language suggestions for the DPA.

Attachments: redline_MSA_Acme_20270108.docx

Thanks — aim to have your notes by Tue EOD so I can meet Acme's timeline.

-Camila

Quoted message: "From: Jillian Moore <jillian@acme-corp.com>" (see above)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Subprocessor change notice — Acme asks (DPA summary + evidence)

Camila,

Thanks — read the redline and drafted a suggested approach. High-level items to call out in the DPA delta summary (I attached a short comparison):

- Subprocessor flow-down: we have to commit to Customer that we will obtain equivalent obligations from EdgeCloud; propose the following language for the DPA delta: "Vendor shall ensure that any subprocessor engaged in the processing of Customer data is bound by written agreements imposing substantially similar data protection obligations as set forth in this DPA."
- Audit rights: Acme requested audit access. Recommend offering (a) right to request SOC 2 report annually, (b) for on-site audit requests require 60 days' notice and scoped to the relevant data processing activities, or (c) offer an independent assessor attestation.
- Incident reporting: propose 72-hour notification for data security incidents involving Customer data.
- Data residency: if EdgeCloud cannot commit to region restrictions, propose scoping the logs to pseudonymized/non-PII telemetry only.

Attachments: DPA_comparison_Acme.xlsx

DocuSign / Order Form flow: we should prepare a clean order form with the EdgeCloud subprocessor listed as a Schedule. I'll create a DocuSign envelope placeholder and share the link so Acme procurement can sign after they accept the DPA deltas.

I've also flagged two redline spots in the MSA that may require exec approval (limitation of liability language changed). Rishi — can you weigh in on any escalations needed?

-Monica Patel
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

--

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Subprocessor change notice — Acme asks (DPA summary + evidence)

Monica/Camila,

Quick security note re: EdgeCloud — I checked their public materials and reached out to their security contact (I also asked them to share SOC 2). Pending SOC 2, here's what I recommend we offer to Acme to avoid a hard stop: 

- Scope the subprocessor to non-sensitive telemetry: sampling of inference logs and metadata only; no raw prompts or PII.
- Require EdgeCloud to accept "incident notification within 72 hours" and to route forensic findings to Redwood and Customer security teams.
- If SOC 2 is not available within 10 business days, we implement a 6-month review clause and additional contractual safeguards (encryption of logs at rest with customer-managed keys if requested).

I can draft the technical addendum language and a short note describing what artifacts we can provide (pen test summary, architecture diagram).

-Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Quoted: Monica's note (see above)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jillian Moore <jillian@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: EdgeCloud Legal <legal@edgecloud.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subprocessor change notice — EdgeCloud + DPA materials attached

Jillian — thanks for the quick reply and for routing procurement. Attached is a consolidated DPA delta summary and our proposed path to approval: 

1) We are proposing the following DPA deltas (high level):
   - Standard flow-down language: we will bind EdgeCloud to substantially similar DPA obligations.
   - Audit / evidence: provide SOC 2 Type II report OR independent assessor attestation; offer scoped on-site audits with 60 days' notice.
   - Incident notification: 72-hour initial notification, 30-day detailed remediation report.
   - Data residency: telemetry limited to pseudonymized metadata if region restriction required.

2) Security mitigations (from Vivek): scope of data, encryption at rest, and a 6-month review clause if SOC 2 not provided within 10 business days.

3) Next steps and timeline:
   - Acme legal to confirm whether the Delta language is acceptable (please mark any must-haves).
   - If accepted, we'll finalize the Order Form and send via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/signing/Acme-MSA-OrderForm
   - Procurement to issue PO upon signed Order Form; estimate 3 business days to process internally.

Attachments: DPA_comparison_Acme.xlsx, redline_MSA_Acme_20270108.docx, subprocessor_list_Q1_2027.pdf

If you prefer, we can also schedule a short call with EdgeCloud's legal/security next week to walk through the evidence.

Looking forward to your confirmation,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

- Please ask EdgeCloud to upload SOC 2 or assessor attestation to the shared drive link by Thu EOD; procurement needs it for our records.
- On the audit right, Acme would prefer the independent assessor attestation route; does Redwood have a preferred assessor to recommend?

Assuming we get SOC 2/attestation by Thu, we expect to have the signed order form and PO in hand by next Tue. Thanks for moving quickly.

Best regards,
Jillian Moore
